scripts.dev: node apps/backend/scripts/free-listen-port.js && node scripts/print-dev-hint.js && concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w aarogya-backend" "npm run dev -w aarogya-frontend"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/backend run lint && npm --prefix apps/frontend run lint
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/backend run build && npm --prefix apps/frontend run build
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:all && npm run test:extended && npm --prefix apps/backend run test:phase1 && npm run golden-path-smoke
